title: Talking, signs & tools
note: A2 - COR - 2x12 - F9 2026-09-03: new leaf, split out of the over-cap a2_ideas dump. Block 1 = saying & replying, block 2 = amounts, help & tools. Paired with a2_verb_patterns at EN_A2_28. · F9 2026-09-03: intro built — recycle table, decision_flow (abstract nouns do not picture), make/have/take collocations. · F9 2026-09-03: response re-glossed — it shared the bare head 'odpověď' with reply, so the twin came back on the next Match board. · F9 2026-09-03: quiz_mode sentence_gap — Quiz/Type are a Czech context sentence with an English gap, not 1-1 translation (James, same note as a2_ideas). sentences[] rewritten to recycle a2_ideas (solution, mistake, shape), adverbs unit 38, transport, home, shopping, family; the short bank moved to use_sentences[] for production. · F9 flags 2026-09-03: level re-lexified (it collocates with high/low, not better/good — James); power moved to the 'moc' sense (a car lacking power to carry people was incongruous — James). · F9 flags 2026-09-03: -body/-one accepts added (canonSynonyms is word-level, so 'no one' cannot be mapped globally).

intro.title: Which word do you need?
labels: You want them to do something?
Then: how much, how many, and which tool you need.
intro.body_cz: Pak: kolik, kolik kusů a jaký nástroj potřebuješ.

intro.title: The verb that goes with it

rows: a promise · a suggestion · a comment

intro.note: **equipment** is uncountable: some equipment, never ~~an equipment~~.
intro.note_cz: **equipment** je nepočitatelné: some equipment, ne ~~an equipment~~.
